profiles.title: Candidates with complete profiles
profiles.description: Contact details, location, desired role and answers about US work authorization and sponsorship, before you talk to anyone.

languages.title: English, Portuguese and Spanish
languages.description: Reach Brazilian and Latino workers living in the US, with the whole site available in their language.

payTransparency.title: Pay range made simple
payTransparency.description: Structured pay fields make it easy to include the pay range, which states like CA, CO, NY and WA require on job posts.

verified.title: Verified companies only
verified.description: Every company is reviewed by our team, so candidates trust the jobs they see and apply with confidence.

free.title: Free, with no job limit
free.description: Post as many jobs as you need at no cost. Edit, close or republish them anytime from your dashboard.

cost.question: How much does it cost?
cost.answer: Posting jobs is currently free, with no job limit and no credit card required.

approval.question: How long does the company review take?
approval.answer: Our team reviews new companies within {days, plural, one {# business day} other {# business days}}. While you wait, you can already create your jobs as drafts.

ein.question: Do I need an EIN?
ein.answer: No. The EIN is optional, so sole proprietors and small businesses without one can sign up too.

confidential.question: Will candidates see my company name?
confidential.answer: No. The job is shown as posted by a confidential company. Your name is only shared in the next steps of the hiring process.

candidates.question: How do I receive the candidates?
candidates.answer: Candidates apply through the platform with a complete profile, and our team contacts you about the ones who match your job.

manage.question: Can I edit or close a job?
manage.answer: Yes. From your dashboard you can edit, close or republish your jobs at any time.

language.question: In which language should I write the job?
language.answer: In the language you prefer. The site works in English, Portuguese and Spanish, and the job text is shown exactly as you wrote it.
